title: A lawsuit has been filed against Anadolu Line correspondent Emre Akbulut
paragraphs: Anadolu Line correspondent Emre Akbulut has been indicted for defaming the news of the relief distribution in earthquake container cities.

According to the indictment, Emre Akbulut insulted a public official with the news of the relief distribution of earthquake container cities published on 21 October 2025. The sentence was carried out by the Turkish Penal Code 125 (designation).
The indictment was passed by Hatay II Criminal Court of Prime Affairs on December 4, 2025. The first hearing will be held on March 19, 2026.
In the case of Emre Akbulut, Attorney Murat Aksoy said the court's motion to dismiss was denied.
Emre Akbulut is a reporter for Hatay at the Anadolu Line. Journalists' organisations said the case could have a deterrent effect on freedom of the press.
The prosecutor's office requests three months to two years in prison for Emre Akbulut. Emre Akbulut is on trial without arrest.
